reservations.noAvailableTables: No tables available for this time and party size. Try another time.

reservations.confirmCancel: Cancel reservation R-{{id}}? This changes the real database.

reservations.selectTable: Choose a table with enough seats after checking availability.
reservations.footerNote: Guest name and phone are stored on the reservation. Older bookings may have no guest contact. Statuses: Confirmed / Cancelled.
reservations.errorFormat: The API returned an unexpected reservation format.

basket.title: Create a new order
basket.subtitle: Choose menu items, review the basket and select a table
basket.noProducts: No menu items found. Add them in Menu & Products first.
basket.noTables: No tables available. Add one in Tables first.
basket.unknownOccupancy: Table occupancy cannot be verified with this API version. Check the table manually.
basket.tableNote: The backend associates the table at checkout only; it does not automatically change the table occupancy.
basket.accountBasketNote: This basket belongs to the signed-in Admin, not to a table. Finish or clear it before taking a different table’s order.
basket.empty: Your basket is empty — add an item from the menu.
basket.confirmClear: Remove all items from your basket?
basket.confirmOrder: Create an order for Table {{table}} with {{count}} item(s) totalling {{total}}? This writes to the live database.
basket.uncertainOrder: The order may have been created even though the response failed. Do NOT retry automatically. Close this dialog and refresh Orders to verify before creating another order.
basket.uncertainBasket: The server state is uncertain. Refresh the basket to check.
basket.errorUnauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
basket.errorForbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
basket.errorNotFound: API endpoint or record was not found.
basket.errorBadRequest: The request was rejected. Check the basket and table.
basket.errorConflict: The data may have changed. Refresh and try again.
basket.errorOrderResponse: The server did not return a valid order ID.

insights.dashboardSubtitle: Live business metrics from your RestaurantAPI.
insights.analyticsSubtitle: Analyze real payments and orders across time.
insights.tableHint: Count only — occupancy data is not yet reliable
insights.topProductsCaveat: Popular products count only orders with a completed recorded payment. Cancelled and unpaid orders are excluded.
insights.partialFailure: Some data could not be loaded.
insights.excludesCancelled: Excludes cancelled orders — not cash received
insights.analyticsMethodology: Revenue uses completed payments grouped by payment date; orders use creation date. Charts use your local calendar. 30/90-day periods are grouped into 5/10-day intervals.

payments.title: Record payment
payments.subtitle: Manual payment receipt for this order
payments.manualOnly: This records a payment already received. It does NOT charge a card or connect to a bank.
payments.confirmCash: I confirm that the restaurant has received this cash payment.
payments.confirmCard: I confirm that this card payment was approved on an external terminal.
payments.confirmSubmit: Record an already received payment of {{amount}} GEL for order #{{id}}? This updates the live database.
payments.alreadyRecorded: A completed payment is already recorded for this order.
payments.alreadyMarkedPaid: This order is already marked Paid. Review the payment history; do not add a duplicate.
payments.unavailable: Payment history is unavailable. Recording payments is disabled until it can be verified.
payments.unverified: Paid status has no verified payment record
payments.success: Payment for order #{{id}} recorded successfully. Refresh Dashboard and Analytics.
payments.uncertain: The server may have saved the payment despite this error. Close this window and refresh Orders before trying again. Do not retry automatically.
